where: /root/loop.sh on blaze-vm: a pushed manifest change without its Cargo.lock line
what: A commit that added a dev-dependency (hegeltest to blaze-engine) was pushed before its Cargo.lock line; the queue`s cargo wrote the line into /root/blaze itself, and the next caller`s `git checkout --detach` stopped with `Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by checkout: Cargo.lock` for every lane until the file was restored (`flock /root/loop.lock git checkout -- Cargo.lock`, done by this lane by hand, which the script`s header forbids).
cost: one failed queue call; the queue was unusable for about a minute
cause: loop.sh builds without `--locked` in a tree it then expects clean
whys: cargo updates a lock file that lacks a line
the shared tree is both a build directory and a checkout
class: a build that writes into the tree it was given
prevention: loop.sh: `cargo build --locked` (the caller sees `the lock file needs to be updated` as its own failure) and `git checkout -f --detach`; on the Mac `cargo metadata --offline` refreshes the lock without building
workaround: refresh and commit Cargo.lock with the manifest
state: open: loop.sh is the main agent`s
